claim.claim-text: 1. A method for transmitting a physical layer protocol data unit, PPDU, within an operating bandwidth in a wireless local area network, the method comprising:

generating a PPDU including a first part and a second part, wherein the first part has a first subcarrier spacing, the second part has a second subcarrier spacing, the first subcarrier spacing is four times greater than the second subcarrier spacing, the first part comprises a first short training field, STF, a first long training field, LTF, a first signal, SIG field, and a second SIG field, the first STF being a legacy-STF, L-STF, the first LTF being a legacy-LTF, L-LTF, the first SIG field being a legacy-SIG, L-SIG, field, and the second part comprises a second STF and a second LTF; and transmitting the PPDU over the operating bandwidth, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the first part, the plurality of sub-channels of the first part comprising a first sub-channel and a second sub-channel, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the second part, the second part having a phase, wherein the first sub-channel of the first part is phase-rotated by multiplying at least one of +1, -1 or +j to the first sub-channel resulting in a phase of the first sub-channel being equal to the phase of the second part, and wherein the second sub-channel of the first part is phase-rotated by multiplying at least one of +1, -1 or +j to the second sub-channel resulting in a phase of the second sub-channel being different from the phase of the second part.

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the operating bandwidth is 40 MHz and the plurality of sub-channels of the first part include two sub-channels, each sub-channel having 20 MHz bandwidth; and wherein the phase of the second sub-channel of the first part is rotated by 90 degrees compared to the phase of the second part.

3. The method of claim 1, wherein the operating bandwidth is 80 MHz and the plurality of sub-channels of the first part include four sub-channels, each sub-channel having 20 MHz bandwidth; and wherein the phase of the second sub-channel of the first part is rotated by 180 degrees compared to the phase of the second part.
4. The method of claim 1, wherein the second SIG field of the first part comprises bandwidth information indicating the operating bandwidth.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein the PPDU comprises a data field associated with the second subcarrier spacing.
6. The method of claim 5, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the data field.
7. The method of claim 6, wherein the data field is phase-rotated by multiplying at least one of +1 or -1 to at least one sub-channel of the plurality of sub-channels of the data field.
8. A device for transmitting a physical layer protocol data unit, PPDU, within an operating bandwidth in a wireless local area network, the device comprising:

a processor configured to cause: generating a PPDU including a first part and a second part, wherein the first part has a first subcarrier spacing, the second part has a second subcarrier spacing, the first subcarrier spacing is four times greater than the second subcarrier spacing, the first part comprises a first short training field, STF, a first long training field, LTF, a first signal, SIG, field, and a second SIG field, the first STF being a legacy-STF, L-STF, the first LTF being a legacy-LTF, L-LTF, the first SIG field being a legacy-SIG, L-SIG, field, and the second part comprises a second STF and a second LTF; and a radio frequency circuitry coupled with the processor configured to cause:

transmitting the PPDU over the operating bandwidth, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the first part, the plurality of sub-channels of the first part comprising a first sub-channel and a second sub-channel, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the second part, the second part having a phase, wherein the first sub-channel of the first part is phase-rotated by multiplying at least one of +1, -1 or +j to the first sub-channel resulting in a phase of the first sub-channel being equal to the phase of the second part, and wherein the second sub-channel of the first part is phase-rotated by multiplying at least one of +1, -1 or +j to the second sub-channel resulting in a phase of the second sub-channel being different from the phase of the second part.

9. The method of claim 8, wherein the operating bandwidth is 40 MHz and the plurality of sub-channels of the first part include two sub-channels, each sub-channel having 20 MHz bandwidth; and wherein the phase of the second sub-channel of the first part is rotated by 90 degrees compared to the phase of the second part.

10. The method of claim 8, wherein the operating bandwidth is 80 MHz and the plurality of sub-channels of the first part include four sub-channels, each sub-channel having 20 MHz bandwidth; and wherein the phase of the second sub-channel of the first part is rotated by 180 degrees compared to the phase of the second part.
11. The method of claim 8, wherein the second SIG field of the first part comprises bandwidth information indicating the operating bandwidth.
12. The method of claim 8, wherein the PPDU comprises a data field associated with the second subcarrier spacing.
13. The method of claim 12, wherein the operating bandwidth is divided into a plurality of sub-channels for transmission of the data field.
14. The method of claim 13, wherein the data field is phase-rotated by multiplying at least one of +1 or -1 to at least one sub-channel of the plurality of sub-channels of the data field.
